decisions.title: Defer production stack selection until after PV-1 evidence and V1 recut
decisions.context: ScopeCareer's authority hierarchy forbids locking framework/vendor choices before semantic/policy contracts and the first category-defining product validation are stable. PV-1 has zero completed ICP sessions at time of writing.
decisions.decision: No production framework, vendor, database, or orchestration choice is ratified before GATE-P3. Candidate technologies may be documented in the longlist (docs/23) but scoring is not run and nothing becomes binding.
decisions.consequences: P3 starts from an evaluated field; short-term work stays on contracts, validation, and planning artifacts. Temptation to 'just pick Postgres now' must be redirected into the candidate longlist.

decisions.title: Adopt contract-first microservice decomposition as reference architecture
decisions.context: Contract domains provide natural service seams: Identity & Tenancy, Career Data Vault, Evidence/Assertion, Opportunity Intelligence, Pursuit Workspace, Access & Relationships, Market Intelligence, AI Orchestration, Ingestion/Capture Gateway, Audit & Observability.
decisions.decision: Treat contract-first microservices as the leading candidate style with the documented decomposition map, sync-vs-async rules, and anti-pattern guardrails. Ratify, adjust, or replace at GATE-P3 using measured workload, cost, and operability evidence from a small team plus coding agents.
decisions.consequences: Non-binding until GATE-P3. Guardrails forbid distributed monoliths and shared databases; early services may start as modules and extract along measured seams. Per-service technology choices remain deferred to P3/P4.
